title: Select
description: Fiori select with the SAP keyboard model (arrows change value while closed; F4 / Alt+↓ open).

usage.summary: Choose one value from a short predefined list without entering free text.
useWhen: Offer a short set of mutually exclusive choices whose option labels are sufficient.
Keep choices collapsed until needed in a form, table or toolbar.
Provide a useful initial choice with defaultValue, or control the selected value with value and onValueChange.

avoidWhen.when: Type to narrow a longer list or accept a value outside the supplied options.
Enter multiple caller-validated values or create tokens from suggestions.
Search across business keys and descriptions or define filter conditions.
Keep every single-choice option visible at once.
